name: DockFix 5.0 Open Graph social card by DockFix 5.0
description: A 1200×630 social card built like an Apple keynote slide: a muted terracotta hillside under a pale blue sky, with a giant black wordmark layered so the horizon ridge slightly occludes its lower edge, giving flat type real depth. The product itself is rendered in place — a glassmorphic macOS-style dock with placeholder-sized icons and widgets sits on the bottom edge like a stage prop. Hierarchy is handled by extreme scale contrast (display wordmark vs. a tiny tracked-out red 'OUT NOW · €14.99' eyebrow) and by confining everything to three strict horizontal bands: metadata, headline, product.
